rows.text: Il cilindro è fisso nel monoblocco; è il pistone a muoversi al suo interno.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — fixed cylinder, moving piston, combustion, four strokes, fuels and drivetrain.

rows.text: La combustione produce gas caldi che spingono il pistone; il movimento viene trasformato in lavoro meccanico.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — fixed cylinder, moving piston, combustion, four strokes, fuels and drivetrain.

rows.text: Depositi sulla punta degli iniettori possono alterare la nebulizzazione: la combustione peggiora e può aumentare il fumo allo scarico.
evidence: Bosch, IAT 004/2015, difetto 3.3.2, p. 24, https://am.bcs-portal.boschaftermarket.com/ar/media/pdf/productos/iat_04-2015_catlogo_de_fallos_no_considerados_como_garantia_para_cr.pdf — carbonizzazione della tobera, polverizzazione errata e fumosità.

rows.text: Il raffreddamento porta all’esterno parte del calore di scarto e impedisce al motore di surriscaldarsi; altro calore esce con i gas di scarico.
evidence: US DOE, Fundamentals Handbook ME-01, p. 12, https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf — coolant removes waste heat; US DOE, Catalog of CHP Technologies, p. 2-8, https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2016/09/f33/catalog_of_chp_technologies.pdf — separate exhaust and coolant heat losses.

rows.text: Quattro tempi indica il ciclo del motore, non un unico combustibile: motori progettati per carburanti diversi possono usare questo ciclo.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — fixed cylinder, moving piston, combustion, four strokes, fuels and drivetrain.

rows.text: I gas della combustione spingono i pistoni e fanno ruotare l’albero motore; la trasmissione porta il movimento alle ruote.
evidence: US Department of Energy, Internal Combustion Engine Basics, https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — fixed cylinder, moving piston, combustion, four strokes, fuels and drivetrain.

rows.text: La bassa pressione riguarda l’alimentazione alla pompa; la pompa di alta pressione porta il gasolio al sistema di iniezione alla pressione necessaria.
evidence: Bosch Mobility, Common-rail system with solenoid injectors, https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — pre-supply pump, high-pressure pump, rail and injectors.

rows.text: La benzina non è il carburante previsto per un normale Diesel: può danneggiare il sistema di alimentazione anche prima di percorrere 200 km.
evidence: RAC, Wrong fuel in your car, https://www.rac.co.uk/drive/advice/know-how/wrong-fuel-recovery/ — petrol reduces diesel fuel lubrication and can damage pump; even short journeys should be avoided.

rows.text: Anche il Diesel aspira aria che deve essere filtrata: il filtro trattiene impurità che possono usurare i componenti.
evidence: MAHLE, Heavy Duty Filtration Insights, https://www.mahle-aftermarket.com/eu/en/automechanika/heavy_duty_filtration_insights/ — intake air filtration protects engine parts.

rows.text: Anche il Diesel usa un filtro del combustibile, che trattiene impurità e protegge il sistema di iniezione.
evidence: MAHLE, Fuel filters, https://www.mahle-aftermarket.com/na/en/products-and-services/filters/fuel-filters/ — diesel fuel filters remove contaminants and separate water.

rows.text: Il Diesel non è generalmente più silenzioso: la combustione per compressione può produrre rumore marcato, anche se isolamento e tecnologia variano.
evidence: US DOE, Just the Basics: Diesel Engine, https://www1.eere.energy.gov/vehiclesandfuels/pdfs/basics/jtb_diesel_engine.pdf — diesel compression ignition and historically loud operation; modern engines have improved.

rows.text: I gas di scarico azionano una turbina collegata a un compressore: più aria entra nel motore, favorendo combustione e potenza con migliore sfruttamento del combustibile.
evidence: Garrett Motion, Turbocharging Facts, https://www.garrettmotion.com/news/newsroom/article/turbocharging-facts-from-garrett-motion/ — exhaust drives compressor; downsizing can improve efficiency at comparable performance. Bosch Mobility, https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — fuel quantity matched to intake air for efficient combustion.

rows.text: Recuperando energia dallo scarico, la sovralimentazione permette a un motore più piccolo di fornire prestazioni comparabili con minore consumo; il risultato dipende dal progetto e dalle condizioni.
evidence: Garrett Motion, Turbocharging Facts, https://www.garrettmotion.com/news/newsroom/article/turbocharging-facts-from-garrett-motion/ — exhaust drives compressor; downsizing can improve efficiency at comparable performance.

rows.text: La turbina sfrutta parte dell’energia dei gas di scarico per azionare il compressore dell’aria aspirata.
evidence: Garrett Motion, Turbocharging Facts, https://www.garrettmotion.com/news/newsroom/article/turbocharging-facts-from-garrett-motion/ — exhaust drives compressor; downsizing can improve efficiency at comparable performance.

rows.text: Comprimendo l’aria si può introdurre una maggiore massa d’aria nei cilindri; il raffreddamento dell’aria compressa ne aumenta ulteriormente la densità.
evidence: Garrett Motion, How a Turbocharger Works, https://www.garrettmotion.com/ko/turbocharger-technology/how-a-turbo-works/basic/ — compressor supplies air; intercooler cools compressed air, increasing density.

rows.text: L’intercooler raffredda l’aria compressa dal turbo: più densa, consente di introdurre più aria nei cilindri e favorisce il rendimento.
evidence: Garrett Motion, How a Turbocharger Works, https://www.garrettmotion.com/ko/turbocharger-technology/how-a-turbo-works/basic/ — compressor supplies air; intercooler cools compressed air, increasing density.

rows.text: Il turbo non impone due silenziatori: la configurazione dello scarico dipende dal progetto del veicolo.
evidence: Volvo Trucks, Where engines are born, https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2014/mar/inside-volvo-where-engines-are-born.html — Euro 6 aftertreatment packaged in one silencer instead of two; Volvo Trucks FL product guide https://www.volvotrucks.com/content/dam/volvo-trucks/markets/master/home/trucks/brochure-gallery/volvo-trucks-volvo-fl-product-guide.pdf — variable geometry turbo engine.

rows.text: Il turbo recupera energia dai gas di scarico e può migliorare il rendimento, oltre ad aumentare la potenza; il risultato dipende dal progetto.
evidence: Garrett Motion, Turbocharging Facts, https://www.garrettmotion.com/news/newsroom/article/turbocharging-facts-from-garrett-motion/ — exhaust drives compressor; downsizing can improve efficiency at comparable performance.

rows.text: Il turbo può ridurre il consumo di combustibile per unità di lavoro prodotto, grazie al recupero di energia dallo scarico; non lo aumenta necessariamente.
evidence: Garrett Motion, Turbocharging Facts, https://www.garrettmotion.com/news/newsroom/article/turbocharging-facts-from-garrett-motion/ — exhaust drives compressor; downsizing can improve efficiency at comparable performance.

rows.text: L’intercooler raffredda l’aria di sovralimentazione, non il liquido di raffreddamento del motore.
evidence: Garrett Motion, How a Turbocharger Works, https://www.garrettmotion.com/ko/turbocharger-technology/how-a-turbo-works/basic/ — compressor supplies air; intercooler cools compressed air, increasing density.

rows.text: Il turbo si usa anche su motori di cilindrata molto superiore a 2.000 cm³, per esempio su motori di autocarri.
evidence: Garrett Motion, Commercial Vehicle DAVNT, https://www.garrettmotion.com/turbocharger-technology/commercial-vehicle-turbochargers/commercial-vehicle-davnt-turbocharger/ — turbo applications include 3, 8 and 13 litre engines.

rows.text: I condotti di scarico raccolgono i gas espulsi dal motore e li convogliano fuori dal veicolo.
evidence: Garrett Motion, How a Turbocharger Works, https://www.garrettmotion.com/ko/turbocharger-technology/how-a-turbo-works/basic/ — compressor supplies air; intercooler cools compressed air, increasing density. US DOE, How Do Diesel Vehicles Work, https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — exhaust aftertreatment system handles engine exhaust.

rows.text: Il quiz indica VERO, ma non è verificato che abbassare la temperatura sia uno scopo generale dello scarico. I gas possono perdere calore lungo il percorso, mentre le reazioni nel catalizzatore possono aumentarlo localmente; lo scarico convoglia i gas e ne tratta rumore ed emissioni.
evidence: DieselNet, Exhaust Gas Thermal Management, https://dieselnet.com/tech/engine_thermal-management.php — exhaust gas heat losses; Walker, Simple Diagnostic Testing, https://www.walkerexhaust.com/support/tech-tips/simple-diagnostic-testing.html — catalyst reactions can increase temperature locally.

Official superiori question 29278 prints VERO and attributes a purpose of lowering exhaust-gas temperature; general design purpose not independently established. Heat transfer alone is not proof of that purpose.

rows.text: Il silenziatore attenua le pulsazioni di pressione e le onde sonore dei gas di scarico, riducendo il rumore.
evidence: Walker Exhaust, Containing Sound, https://www.walkerexhaust.com/support/tech-tips/containing-sound.html — muffler chambers and absorptive elements reduce sound and exhaust pulsation noise.

rows.text: Il quiz indica VERO, ma non ogni piccola crepa richiede sempre la sostituzione. Fai valutare il componente: può servire sostituirlo oppure, se consentito e idoneo, eseguire una riparazione durevole che rispetti i requisiti di rumore ed emissioni.
evidence: Official superiori 29280 prints VERO for replacement even for small cracks.

Northern Ireland DVA https://www.infrastructure-ni.gov.uk/articles/exhaust-system accepts certain structurally sound durable repairs; inspection guidance is not Italian law and does not establish a universal right to repair. UK DVSA https://www.gov.uk/guidance/mot-inspection-manual-for-private-passenger-and-light-commercial-vehicles/8-nuisance concerns exhaust noise/emissions inspection.

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
reviewer_evidence: Walker https://www.walkerexhaust.com/support/tech-tips/simple-diagnostic-testing.html explains conversion can heat exhaust at a catalyst; revised 29278 distinguishes physical heat transfer from an unverified general exhaust purpose. Northern Ireland DVA https://www.infrastructure-ni.gov.uk/articles/exhaust-system allows certain durable repairs subject to structural conditions, not a statement of Italian law.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata VERO richiede sempre la sostituzione della marmitta anche per piccole crepe o rotture. La fonte tecnica pubblica consultata ammette riparazioni durevoli e alcune perdite minori: non è stata trovata un’autorità italiana specifica che confermi l’obbligo assoluto di sostituzione o ne chiarisca il campo. Serve adjudicazione indipendente.
checked_sources: Department for Infrastructure, Exhaust System, DVT 932 issue 6, https://www.infrastructure-ni.gov.uk/articles/exhaust-system — ammette riparazioni durevoli che eliminino perdite e non respinge alcune perdite minori; non definisce la regola italiana.

UK DVSA, MOT inspection manual, 8.1, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/mot-inspection-manual-for-private-passenger-and-light-commercial-vehicles/8-nuisance — valuta rumore e integrità, senza stabilire la sostituzione obbligatoria per ogni piccola crepa; non è normativa italiana.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
issues: 29278: The source marks true an assertion that an exhaust system’s task is to lower exhaust-gas temperature. The explanation only says heat can be lost in transit and temperature varies; incidental possible heat loss does not establish cooling as a design purpose. The cited Walker technical guide shows a catalytic converter can increase gas temperature, and DieselNet describes keeping catalysts hot. Explain the scope and visible uncertainty rather than presenting an incidental effect as a verified purpose.
reviewer_evidence: Northern Ireland DVA https://www.infrastructure-ni.gov.uk/articles/exhaust-system expressly permits durable, leak-preventing repairs where the system remains structurally sound. It does not state Italian law. Walker https://www.walkerexhaust.com/support/tech-tips/simple-diagnostic-testing.html says converter outlet gas can be hotter because conversion produces heat.
